scope: Current dirty Cerisse worktree; BVH backend; STL reader; read_geom; surface ownership/output; Test 1853 SI tri smoke test
worktree_notice: The audited IBM source files contain uncommitted user changes. File hashes below, not repository_head alone, identify the audited source snapshot.

runtime_smoke_test.notes: One CPU rank, one very short step, ib.skip_validation=0, ib.plot_surf=0, plot/checkpoint output disabled. This proves practical reader/BVH compatibility of the tested binary and STL; it is not a physics validation or proof that the executable was built from the dirty source hashes above.

assumptions: 3-D LP64 DOUBLE build: Real=8 bytes and int=4 bytes
Nominal payload only; allocator capacity, UVM bookkeeping, fluid state, GPStore, AMR data, communication buffers, and build-time temporaries are excluded
Projected meshes use the measured Test 1853 BVH4/facet ratio and approximately V=F/2

gather_surf_data.conclusion: The 18.4M-, 28.75M-, and 73.61M-face theoretical meshes cannot use the current single-call byte MPI_Gatherv surface-output path.

compatibility.current_approximately_360k_face_models: Compatible for reader/BVH bring-up when one complete closed SI STL is loaded.
compatibility.formal_submillimetre_high_resolution_mod: Not capacity-compatible with the current replicated geometry, replicated per-face surface arrays, and rank-0 gather/output design without the changes prioritised in IBM_HANDOFF_REPORT_CN.md section 17.
